context: Banner reads findings counts via the same connection the command already holds (zero extra round-trips on the hosted path — piggyback the existing query batch); unsynced-draft count is a local directory glob, no credentials needed. Skill edits go through skill-sync (todo-db skill source in ~/.skill-sync; PR carries skill-sync.lock). AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md edits follow the docs-brevity house style: dense, no repeated content.
description: Requirement 2 (findings naturally considered during planning) is satisfied by riding the commands agents already run, NOT by a new entry-point command — 'todo ready' is hardcoded as the planning entry in at least a dozen surfaces (todo-db SKILL.md:19, references/implement.md:1-3, references/batch.md:62-66, AGENTS.md:307, spec :210,:231, CLAUDE.md allowlist), and agents follow skills mechanically, so a 'todo plan' command they are never routed to would never run. Precedent that surfacing-in-existing-commands works: deferrals appear in the claim work order and stats counts today. This phase adds a one-line banner to 'todo ready' and 'todo stats' output — 'N open findings, M unsynced drafts — todo finding candidates' — suppressed cleanly when both counts are zero, and updates every routing surface in the same change. 'todo plan' is explicitly DEFERRED until the banner is measured insufficient (success metrics in the findings-domain spec).

anti_patterns.dont: Break ready's machine-readable output by interleaving the banner
anti_patterns.instead: Banner on stderr or as a clearly-separated trailing line; pin with a test
anti_patterns.why: Automation and batch scheduling parse ready output

anti_patterns.dont: Ship a 'todo plan' command as the primary surfacing mechanism
anti_patterns.instead: Banner on ready/stats; defer plan until metrics show the banner insufficient
anti_patterns.why: A dozen surfaces route agents to 'ready'; a parallel entry point splits the flow and goes unused — the adversarial review's M2
